Classic Reefer Madness from Drug Watch International:
"MARIJUANA USED BY JONESBORO KILLERS"!

For immediate release:

From Drug Watch International and The International Drug Strategy Institute

CONTACT:

Eric A. Voth, M.D., FACP Chairman

The International Drug Strategy Institute 785-354-9591

Janet Lapey, M.D., President

Drug Watch International 617-826-5598

MARIJUANA USED BY JONESBORO KILLERS

Marijuana has long been underestimated in its link to violent crime. As reported in the New York Times (3/29/98), the adolescents involved in the Jonesboro killings were reputed to be marijuana smokers. The association to murder and other violence is not isolated. (Examples attached).

Dr. Eric Voth, chairman of the International Drug Strategy Institute commented: "Marijuana creates an atmosphere of reduced inhibition. This is seen with many behaviors suc (sic) as unsafe sex, and the association with violent crime is clear".

Dr. Janet Lapey, President of Drug Watch International added, "The marijuana lobby would have the public believe that marijuana is a harmless drug. The victims of crime would feel otherwise".

EXAMPLES OF CRIMINAL ACTIVITIES

CHICAGO TRIBUNE 5/96 - Two who threw a 5-year-old from a building regular smokers of marijuana

MINNEAPOLIS STAR TRIBUNE 9/22/96 - Year old regular marijuana user kills friend's brother for his truck

SAINT PAUL PIONEER PRESS 5/3/95 - 14-year-old stabs 4-year-old, regular marijuana smoker

SAINT PAUL PIONEER PRESS 1/22/94 - Teenager kills another teenager over marijuana while using pot

(Ed. note: The evidence is truly overwhelming.)
